# Camera

`cinnabar:extension/camera@0.1.0`

Opt-in local camera policy; requires the explicit camera grant.

**Grants:** `camera`.

## Types

<a id="type-view-tilt"></a>

### `view-tilt`

Degrees, each at most `MAX_VIEW_TILT_DEGREES`, added to the first-person view where the
native damage shake applies; suppress-hurt-shake removes that shake. Positive pitch turns
the view up. Positive roll turns it the way a native shake without direction does: the
view's right edge rises, so the world appears to turn clockwise. A native shake of angle
`a` from hurt direction `d` is approximately roll `a cos d` and pitch `-a sin d`.
Death rotation, view bob, look and movement are unchanged.

```wit
record view-tilt {
    roll: f32,
    pitch: f32,
    suppress-hurt-shake: bool,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `roll` | `f32` |  |
| `pitch` | `f32` |  |
| `suppress-hurt-shake` | `bool` |  |

<a id="type-damage-shake"></a>

### `damage-shake`

The native damage shake of the local player's last presented view, at full strength:
before the player's damage-shake setting, any mod `view-tilt`, or suppression. Degrees,
using the `view-tilt` sign convention: a tilt of these angles that suppresses the native
shake presents the same view. None while no shake is active, in third person, or outside
gameplay. Like a tilt, it continues while a menu owns input.

```wit
record damage-shake {
    roll: f32,
    pitch: f32,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `roll` | `f32` |  |
| `pitch` | `f32` |  |

## Functions

<a id="set-view-tilt"></a>

### `set-view-tilt`

```wit
set-view-tilt: func(tilt: option<view-tilt>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Current frame only, including while a menu owns input. None, omission, unload and failed
callbacks restore the native view.

Types: [`view-tilt`](camera.md#type-view-tilt).

<a id="set-preserve-teleport-rotation"></a>

### `set-preserve-teleport-rotation`

```wit
set-preserve-teleport-rotation: func(enabled: bool) -> result<_, string>;
```

Renew every frame. Only actual teleports preserve yaw/pitch; position and acknowledgments remain unchanged.
Omission, no gameplay frame, or a failed callback restores server rotation.

<a id="set-view-scale"></a>

### `set-view-scale`

```wit
set-view-scale: func(fov-scale: f32, look-scale: f32) -> result<_, string>;
```

Current-frame FOV and look multipliers, independently bounded to 0.1..1 and 0.05..1.
Renew only during focused, input-owned gameplay; 1/1 restores the player's view.
Omission, UI focus, unload, and failed callbacks restore both scales without changing saved settings or perspective.

<a id="read-damage-shake"></a>

### `read-damage-shake`

```wit
read-damage-shake: func() -> result<option<damage-shake>, string>;
```

Requires the camera grant.

Types: [`damage-shake`](camera.md#type-damage-shake).
